title: 可解释的DistilBERT-BiLSTM-Attention框架用于二元与多类仇恨言论检测
summary: 该研究提出一种结合DistilBERT、Bi-LSTM与注意力机制的多层级可解释仇恨言论检测框架，并使用LIME增强透明度。在两个基准数据集上，二元分类F1达96.78%和99.53%，多类分类F1达97.00%和94.99%，优于现有基线。
summary_en: This study proposes a multilevel, explainable hate speech detection framework integrating DistilBERT embeddings, Bi-LSTM, and attention, with LIME for transparency. It achieves F1-scores of 96.78% and 99.53% in binary classification and 97.00% and 94.99% in multi-class settings across two benchmark datasets, outperforming baselines.
